item.title: Looking for games with grimy, oppressive atmosphere (think SH2 remake prison level, Condemned)
item.author: invalid@example.com (wafflebrain)
item.dc:creator: wafflebrain
item.content:encoded: Was playing the demo to a game recently called Divine Frequency and it has one of the most oppressive and dirty feeling environments and vibes I've felt in awhile, but sadly learned its made by chuds so that took the enjoyment out of that, so I'm on the hunt for something that is similar. Doesn't have to be combat focused necessarily, just looking for a bleak, heavy feeling world to get lost in. Tis the season with shorter days post daylight savings, so the darker the better.
